parties: Amber Enterprises India Limited; IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited (material subsidiary)
headline: Amber Enterprises India: Material Subsidiary IL JIN Electronics Issues 30.49 Crore Bonus Equity Shares
sum: Amber Enterprises' material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited allotted 30,49,12,000 equity shares to the parent company pursuant to a bonus issue under SEBI LODR Regulation 30. The transaction represents a capital restructuring within the subsidiary group, expanding parent shareholding without cash outlay.
implication: Bonus issuances by material subsidiaries to parent entities trigger SEBI LODR disclosure obligations and may implicate subsidiary valuation, consolidated shareholding concentration, and internal transfer pricing norms under ITA 1961 §92; counsel should verify compliance with CAP policy and board approval thresholds.
detail: IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, identified as a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited, conducted a bonus share allotment on 17 August 2026, resulting in the issuance of approximately 30.49 crore equity shares to the parent company. The allotment was notified to NSE under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 (material events), which mandates prompt disclosure of acquisitions by listed companies or their material subsidiaries. The transaction did not involve cash consideration; it represents a capitalisation of reserves within the subsidiary structure, thereby increasing the parent's equity stake in IL JIN.
